_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Rules:
- On your turn, you may either:
  1) Make a new bid with a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than the current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Call the last bid by typing '[Call]'.

If you call:
  - If the actual count of that face value among all dice is less than the bid, the last bidder loses one die.
  - Otherwise, the caller loses one die.
A player who reaches 0 dice is eliminated. The last remaining player wins.

board.new_round:
Ronda nobo - Dadi restante: {dice_summary}
Bo dadi aktual ta: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Hungador {current_player_id} yama! E konteo real di cara {face_value} ta {count}, ku ta MENOS ku {quantity}.
Hungador {loser_id} (e ultimo oferente) perde un dadi.
call.caller_loses:
Hungador {current_player_id} yama! E konteo real di cara {face_value} ta {count}, ku ta >= {quantity}.
Hungador {loser_id} (e yamador) perde un dadi.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: E yamada a ser hasi sin un oferta previo.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Aksion no ta rekonosi komo un '[Bid: X, Y]' valioso ni '[Call]' valioso. Aksion presentá: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: E kantidat nobo {new_quantity} ta mas abou ku e aktualnan di {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: E balor nominal nobo {new_face_value} ta mas abou ku e balor aktual di {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: E oferta ta identico cu e oferta actual.
bid_reason.face_range: E balor nominal mester ta entre 1 i 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: E hungadó {player_id} a keda eliminá pa move inválido.
